Copy of https://github.com/arnaud-carre/AtariAudio, commit 8471e8492a4cfe44c874352fcce97b9a8dfdeef8 (AtariAudio 1.26), MIT licence (see LICENSE). Used as a test oracle (ymcore) and, since M7, to play SNDH files (D-159).

Only change (STYM2149, M7, 16/10/2026), marked "STYM2149" in the code: an observer of the writes to the chip port (`AtariMachine::SetYmPortObserver`, `AtariMachine::YmWritePort`), in `src/AtariMachine.h` and `src/AtariMachine.cpp`. The machine's six writes to the chip (`memWrite8`, `memWrite16`, Xbios(32) DoSound) go through it; the observer is also called at each exit from a timer interrupt (`AtariMachine::ComputeNextSample`, port `YM_OBSERVER_TIMER_IRQ_END`), so that the SNDH capture reproduces the "square-sync" edge reset of `Ym2149c::InsideTimerIrq`; without an observer, the behaviour is the original one. All other files are unchanged.
